thread.title: How Facebook’s Earnings Debacle Is Affecting Other Stocks

author: Nicholas Jasinski
title: How Facebook’s Earnings Debacle Is Affecting Other Stocks
text:
By Nicholas Jasinski July 26, 2018 8:40 a.m. ET Facebook (FB) shares are down more than 20% in premarket trading Thursday, after the firm released disappointing second-quarter earnings after Wednesday’s close. The social- media giant reported user numbers below expectations, and predicted slowing growth and rising costs in coming quarters. The company has been a key driver of a crowded “FANG+” trade, as well as a broader rally in tech shares that has led markets this year. Given Facebook’s mega-cap size, it alone makes up more than 2% of the market value of the S&P 500, making its loss equal to approximately 0.4% of the index if it holds. The bloodletting seems to be largely limited to Facebook, however. Shares of other related companies are down much less.
